title: Higher-order estimates of highest waves of the Whitham equation
summary: The Whitham equation has given its name to a wider family of nonlocal, nonlinear equations with very weak dispersion, which all feature highest waves. Recent work by Ehrnström, Maehlen and Varholm establishes leading-order asymptotics at the crest of solutions to such Whitham-type equations, and conjectures similar expansions for all derivatives of the solution. By extending their techniques we confirm the conjecture for a range of equations with highest waves of Hölder regularity $C^{s}$ for $s\in[0.35,1)$.
